name: omp-plugin-duplicate-detector
description: Code clone and duplication detector plugin for oh-my-pi powered by jscpd

omp.name: duplicate-detector
omp.description: Detect duplicate and clone code blocks across your codebase powered by jscpd

minLines.description: Minimum consecutive lines required to report a duplicate block

minTokens.description: Minimum token count threshold for code clone detection

checkOnMutation.description: Automatically check newly written/edited code for duplicates

reminderMode.description: Feedback style: steer (live TTSR warning card & steer message), in-band (<system-reminder> on tool_result), or none

ignorePatterns.description: Additional comma-separated glob patterns to ignore during duplicate detection

ignoreTests.description: Automatically ignore test files, test directories, mocks, and fixtures across all programming languages

maxIndexedFiles.description: Maximum number of source code files to index during baseline initialization
